_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA muscle labels. Assigned from each cluster's 50-gene marker set under the rule used for the other organs: the label is visible but is not evidence, and where the markers contradict it the markers decide. null is an explicit abstention, not a miss.
_curated: 2026-08-21; markers read per cluster, CL release 2026-06-08
_disagreements: Satellite cell -> skeletal muscle satellite cell: PAX7 and MYF5 are definitive, and the resolver reached smooth muscle myoblast (CL:0000514) -- the same mapping error skin produced for the same label. Lymphoid cell -> T cell: CD3E, with SKAP1 and GZMM. Inflammatory cell -> monocyte: S100A8, S100A12, MNDA and CSTA; the label's own term is near-vacuous. Recorded as monocyte rather than classical monocyte: nothing in the markers separates classical from non-classical. Myeloid cell -> CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell: MHC class II heavy with CD1C. Vascular endothelial cell -> vein endothelial cell: ACKR1 and SELE are venular. Fast skeletal muscle cell -> fast muscle cell: MYL1, MYLPF, CKM and TNNC2 support the finer term the label implies but the resolver generalised away.
_abstentions: Eight of twenty-three, which is high and worth stating: this organ's clusters look driven by cell STATE rather than identity. T cell carries a cell-cycle signature (CDK1, UBE2C, RRM2, PTTG1) with no CD3 or any lineage gene; Megakaryocyte carries an interferon-response programme (IFI44L, IFIT3, IFI6) with no PF4, PPBP or GP9; CD8 T cell is entirely pseudogenes. Mesenchymal cell (33,125 cells, the largest in the organ) and Muscle progenitor cell show only housekeeping genes, the latter without PAX7, MYF5 or MYOD1. Skeletal muscle cell carries no myofibre gene at all -- no MYH, ACTA1, CKM or TTN. Neuron's markers are mesenchymal apart from NPY. Adipocyte lacks ADIPOQ, LEP, PLIN1 and FABP4. Together these are about 59,000 cells to which no cell type can honestly be assigned.
_recuration: Re-curated 2026-08-21 from the markers alone, after the first pass was made with the pipeline's own candidate ranking visible in the sheet. That ranking is one of the two things the gold exists to score, so its presence made the measurement partly circular -- the same failure this study documents for the label. The sheets no longer carry it. Re-deriving every call from the marker genes changed exactly one: Inflammatory cell, from classical monocyte to monocyte, because the 'classical' qualifier had come from the ranking rather than the genes.
